    output reg [8:0] dist // 3x3 matrix output for shortest paths

    input reset,
    input signed [15:0] x,         // Input signal
    input signed [15:0] d,         // Desired signal
    output reg signed [15:0] y     // Output signal
);
    reg signed [15:0] w [0:N-1];   // Weights
    reg signed [15:0] e;            // Error signal
    parameter signed [15:0] mu = 16'h0001; // Step size parameter

    integer i;
    
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin
                w[i] <= 16'h0000; // Initialize weights to zero
            end
            y <= 16'h0000; // Output signal reset
        end else begin
            // Compute output signal
            y <= 16'h0000; // Reset output
            for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin
                y <= y + (w[i] * x); // Filter output
            end
            
            // Compute error
            e <= d - y; // Error signal
            
            // Update weights
            for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin
                w[i] <= w[i] + (mu * e * x); // LMS weight update
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
